description: Figure 6(a) presents the video type distribution for the benchmark dataset. The chart is a pie chart, visually representing the proportion of different video types within the dataset. The pie chart is divided into two distinct slices: one larger slice, colored light gray, and a smaller slice, colored dark gray. The light gray slice, which constitutes the majority of the chart, represents 64% of the total, while the dark gray slice represents the remaining 36%. The chart is labeled "(a) Video type distribution." and is part of a larger figure captioned "Figure 6: The basic information of our benchmark data."
